title: Local PERSUBENTMGR parser lineage screen
scope: Check two locally available DWG reader projects for independent PERSUBENTMGR wire fields or semantic member evidence before repeating corpus acquisition.

sources.head: 70bb845b
sources.worktree: Dirty only in cpp/tests/standalone/cad_write_rejection_manifest_smoke.cpp; inspected parser source file is clean.
sources.observed: The source explicitly identifies itself as a port of parseObjects.ts. It reads a bounded classVersion and itemCount, retains the remaining body as rawData, then reads item handles from the handle stream. The DXF reader maps the first post-subclass group 90 to classVersion and post-subclass group 330 values to itemHandles.
sources.limitation: This preserves unknown body bytes; it does not interpret selected-member semantics or independently bind the DWG body tail.

sources.head: 216e5c4b
sources.worktree: Dirty, including cpp/src/dwg/tables/TableParsers.cpp and cpp/src/dwg/DwgObjectsReader.cpp; inspected parser source file differs from HEAD.
sources.observed: The parser also explicitly identifies parseObjects.ts as its source and uses the same classVersion/itemCount/rawData/handle-stream structure as dwg-writer.
sources.limitation: Shared TypeScript ancestry and the dirty worktree make this neither independent evidence nor a source-bound physical wire trace.

decision: Do not treat these local projects as independent schema or semantic support. Their agreement is explained by a shared parseObjects.ts port lineage; both preserve the disputed body as raw data.
next: Do not repeat this source scan unless source provenance changes. P6-B still requires native API-state evidence for exact AcDbPersSubentManager creation and a selected nonzero path, followed by independent field, handle-role, and next-object-span proof.
